title: Users

description.owner: Find any shop or CoreUp account and help people who are locked out: set a new password or send a set-password link
description.readOnly: Search and view accounts of every shop. Only the CoreUp owner can reset passwords

reason.label: Reason (kept in the audit log)
reason.placeholder: e.g. forgot the password and got no email; the user contacted us on LINE

teamWarning: This is a CoreUp team account. Changing its password affects sign-in to this back office and is logged.

error.self: You cannot do this to your own account; change your password in account security instead
error.noEmail: This account signs in with LINE only and has no real email to set a password for

reset.title: Reset password for {{name}}
reset.modeLabel: How to set the new password
reset.generateHint: The system generates a readable 12-character password and shows it once after you confirm.
reset.sideEffects: On confirm the user is signed out of every device and the old password stops working.
reset.messageLabel: Message ready to send on LINE
reset.onceWarning: This password is shown once. After you close this window it cannot be shown again; the plain password is never stored.

link.title: Send set-password link to {{name}}
link.description: Creates a one-time link valid for 1 hour that you can pass on over LINE, no email needed.
link.sideEffects: The user opens the link and sets a new password; they are then signed out of every device.

revoke.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere
revoke.description: Currently signed in on {{count}} device(s). All of them must sign in again; the password stays the same.

detail.title: User details
detail.description: Shops, recent sign-ins and what the team did to this account (IP addresses are partly hidden)
detail.selfHint: This is your own account: you cannot reset or sign yourself out here.
detail.ownerOnly: Only the CoreUp owner can reset passwords or sign users out.
detail.noSignIns: No device is signed in right now
detail.recentActions: What the team did to this account

tab.title: Users of this shop
tab.empty: This shop has no users yet
